messages:
ali: Starting a focused admin entitlement census for key-bound principals today. Target: identify ownerless KMS bindings and stale admin roles (>180d inactivity).
frank: ETA? and are we auto-revoking or ticketing?
ali: Short window: collect + dry-run today, staging revokes tomorrow, small prod canary Friday. Auto-revoke only for svcacct where last_auth>540d AND no deployments. others -> manual ticket.
meera: Can you share the query for KMS binds? want to cross-check cert rotation jobs first.
ali: gcp example I used: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy KEY --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role|test("cryptoKey.*Admin|roles/cloudkms.admin"))'`
meera: perfect. Exclude HSM-backed keys and anything listed in cert-rotation owner tag.
ops-bot: [audit] ownermap snapshot uploaded: s3://redwood-audit/1758123456/ownermap.csv (ali)
frank: vuln note: scanner found legacy /v0/roles/attach accepting unauthenticated grants in one service. That service should be exempt until patch.
ali: noted. add to exclusion list. SEC ticket if not already.
sec-bot: [jira] SEC-3001 created: "legacy role-attach endpoint - quarantine" assigned to infra-api.
meera: rollback plan? we need tfstate snapshots and revert PRs pre-made.
ali: yes - snapshot -> s3://redwood-state/sweeps/1758123456.tfstate, revert PR for each batch, and a 60m monitor window post-change. Pager to sec-oncall on >3 failed auth checks.
frank: splitting targets into batches low/med/high. I'll push the lists to the ticket and run dry-run diffs.
ali: thanks — please post dry-run outputs in the ticket and tag sec-oncall before staging revokes. Will notify #eng-oncall for the prod canary.
